page.layout: One printed page (right page of the opening). Top: woodcut ornament, then a title head across the full width, with a subtitle paragraph below it. Then a letter "A." centred. Below: two columns of Greek word lists with page and line references (left column with a large woodcut initial A, right column continuing). Bottom right: a signature "Z 5". Left margin: a fragment of the facing page's text, which is not part of this page and is not transcribed.

main_text.head: INDEX ANOMALORUM, nec non difficiliorum in Novo Testamento Vocabulorum, quorum origo discentibus prima fronte non est obvia: ubi primus numerus indicat in Manuali hoc paginam, secundus vero illius paginae lineam.
A.

page.notes: The Greek words are printed in a small italic-like hand and are read with uncertainty in many places; the accents and breathings are approximate. The woodcut at the top is an ornament, not a title illustration. The left-margin fragment belongs to the facing page and is omitted.
